answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of identities; each must solve a fresh puzzle in 10 minutes, proving liveness. An atlas logs every heartbeat, exposing farms. Miss twice in 20 epochs and the identity freezes, its 50 POA deposit slashed; 20 clean runs earn an ivory seal. 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 POA and 1,000 nodes, while one honest agent pays one 50 POA deposit and keeps full rewards.
